meta.name: hunt-deserialization
meta.description: Hunt Insecure Deserialization — Java gadget chains (ysoserial), PHP object injection (phpggc), Python pickle RCE, .NET BinaryFormatter, Ruby Marshal.load, JNDI/Log4Shell. RCE via deserialization is almost always Critical. Use when target runs Java, PHP serialization, Python pickle, .NET, or Ruby on Rails.

copy.tagline: 检测并利用反序列化漏洞实现远程代码执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Java、PHP、Python等应用中挖掘反序列化漏洞
copy.tagline_en: Detect and exploit deserialization vulnerabilities for remote code execution
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find deserialization flaws in Java, PHP, Python, .NET, or Ruby apps

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你检测和利用不安全的反序列化漏洞，包括 Java、PHP、Python、.NET、Ruby 和 Log4Shell 等场景，并生成对应的攻击载荷。
howto.when: 当目标运行 Java、PHP 序列化、Python pickle、.NET 或 Ruby on Rails 时触发。

say.text: 帮我检测这个网站是否有 Java 反序列化漏洞。
测试这个 API 端点是否存在 Python pickle 反序列化漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会生成 pickle 载荷并发送请求。

say.text: 检查这个登录接口是否有 Log4Shell 漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会在多个请求头中注入 JNDI 探测字符串。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps detect and exploit insecure deserialization vulnerabilities, including Java, PHP, Python pickle, .NET, Ruby, and Log4Shell, and generates corresponding attack payloads.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the target runs Java, PHP serialization, Python pickle, .NET, or Ruby on Rails.

say_en.text: Check this website for Java deserialization vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude will look for AC ED 00 05 signatures and generate ysoserial payloads.

say_en.text: Test this API endpoint for Python pickle deserialization.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a pickle payload and send the request.

say_en.text: Check this login endpoint for Log4Shell.
say_en.note: Claude will inject JNDI probe strings in multiple headers.
